# PROCESS — cand_0008 (parent cand_0005, current champion, val 0.604)

## Method
Diagnosed THIS iteration's `./trajectories/` (cand_0005 rollouts) with a 4-way read-only
subagent fan-out covering all 36 failing tasks (partials / sheet-level always-fail /
two cell-level always-fail groups), then verified the one shipped lever against the raw traces
myself. Reconfirmed from LEDGER/JOURNAL: standard formulas recalc & pass (never "prefer literals");
the last TWO iterations (cand_0006 −0.044, cand_0007 −0.022) both regressed by adding
formula/recalc prose — that lever is refuted and NOT re-tried.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = # failing tasks × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag | action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Idiosyncratic OUTPUT CONVENTION on structural tasks, but the workbook SHIPS a demonstration/expected sheet the agent inspected yet didn't use as the spec | 250-20 ('Desired outcome' sheet — wrong survivor row), 146-49 (sample answer at row 1 — wrong ordering), 398-14 (existing COLLECTION shows 0 — agent wrote "-") | Agent picks the convention that fits the one visible case; a demonstration sheet already pins ordering/survivor/blank-vs-0/label/layout, but the prompt never told it to treat that sheet as authoritative for those ambiguous decisions | CONTRACT / KNOWLEDGE (additive, builds on cand_0003's ACCEPTED workbook-reuse rule) | **SHIPPED** (1 edit, prompt.md) |
| 2 | Static value written instead of a live/derived formula for a per-row/aggregate answer | 47699, 4225, 50486, 32023 | agent computes in Python, bakes a literal | — | **SKIP — REFUTED**: cand_0006 & cand_0007 both shipped "write COUNTIF/formula not literal" and regressed (broke standard-formula writers / noise) |
| 3 | Modern/array/CSE formula returns blank under LibreOffice recalc | 53023 (XLOOKUP), 55258 (NUMBERVALUE), 58890 (array INDEX/MATCH), 6698 (array-constant COUNTIFS) | grader can't recalc these | — | **SKIP — REFUTED**: cand_0006 (array-CSE avoid-list) −0.044, cand_0007 (_xlfn) −0.022 |
| 4 | Value-type fidelity — string-clean op stringifies an already-numeric cell | 585-41 (1/3) | agent coerces numeric→text | CONTRACT | **SKIP — UNVERIFIED**: prompt already asserts the scorer coerces "plain numeric string" → number, so I cannot confirm this edit would flip 585-41; an unverified contract claim is a guess. Dropped. |
| 5 | Interpretation-variance (idiosyncratic / self-contradictory / under-specified gold) | 34-5, 157-4, 267-18, 269-44, 347-49, 413-15, 577-40, 10281, 14207, 30930, 32468, 32975, 39946, 49782, 50526, 50755, 53305, 53449, 55039, 55912, 58484 | no derivable general rule from prose | — | **SKIP** — no safe general fix (several are single-task boundary/predicate semantics a general rule can't encode without hardcoding that task) |
| — | INFRA / non-prose-fixable | 269-44 (literal-correct output scored 0), 34-5 ("current month" frozen against a past calendar date, no anchor in the file) | environment / frozen-clock | — | **HAND BACK** |

## Edit kept (1; prompt.md; WRITE-GENERAL-CODE section, new final bullet)
**Demonstration-sheet convention matching.** Added a bullet: when the workbook contains a sheet
named like "Desired outcome"/"Expected"/"Result"/"After"/"Sample"/"Example" (or a worked example
already inside the answer range), treat it as the AUTHORITATIVE spec for the ambiguous decisions —
ordering, which row survives a merge/consolidate/dedupe, empty→0-vs-blank-vs-"-", exact label
wording/casing, and layout — reproduce those CONVENTIONS and re-derive them on the hidden files;
do NOT copy the demonstration's example-specific VALUES.

- **VERIFY-THE-FIX:**
  - 250-20 trace: sheets `['RNM','Desired outcome']`; the 'Desired outcome' sheet spells out the
    consolidated result, but the agent kept the first-appearance row and its own survivor choice,
    diverging on case 2 where group members differ in non-key columns. Matching the demo's survivor
    convention resolves it.
  - 146-49 trace: the file's sample answer (KAGOULE|KAGOULS) sits at row 1; the agent emitted it at
    row 65 (scan order), so one offset failed the whole G1:H65 range. Matching the demo's ordering
    fixes the offset.
  - 398-14 trace: the file's own COLLECTION shows RET=0 for the QQ row where the agent wrote "-".
    Reproducing the demo's 0-vs-"-" convention removes the mismatch.
- **BLAST RADIUS — BOUNDED (additive, conditional).** Fires only when a demonstration sheet /
  worked example is present. Passing formula-writers (2768, 31420, 35747, 37962, 44264, …) write
  into blank cells with no such demo → rule does not fire; passing tasks that already have and
  match such a sheet keep the same artifact. It extends the ACCEPTED cand_0003 "reuse the workbook
  method" rule (positive direction) toward output CONVENTIONS, a distinct facet, placed as a NEW
  bullet rather than editing the widest-blast existing paragraph, to contain the radius. Residual
  risk: a passing task whose second sheet is actually input data could be misread as a demo —
  mitigated by naming the specific demo-marker sheet names and "worked example inside the answer
  range", and by forbidding value-copying (the anti-hardcode rule still holds).

## Deliberately NOT re-tried (prior RESULTS refuted — never re-test)
- "Write COUNTIF/formula instead of a Python literal for aggregates" and every array/modern/CSE
  formula rule — cand_0006 (−0.044, broke 35747/41410/42930/50250/56561) and cand_0007 (−0.022,
  broke 399-14/430-43/45581). This is why «redacted» are left.
- "Prefer literals over formulas" globally (cand_0001).
- Independent/adversarial VERIFY rewrite of task_template step 3 (cand_0002 REJECTED). I deliberately
  put the demo-sheet lever in prompt.md as KNOWLEDGE, NOT as a step-3 verify rewrite, to stay clear
  of this refuted structure.
- Global no-embellishment / leave-#N/A / don't-fill-blank block (cand_0002, 4 breaks).
- cand_0004's workbook-reuse SOFTENING + "number-formats never graded" clause (net-zero).

## Plateau signal
RESULTs: +0.022, +0.000, +0.011, +0.000, +0.011, −0.044, −0.022 — a genuine, well-confirmed
plateau; the two most recent iterations regressed. Four independent diagnostic passes agree the
residual 36 are overwhelmingly interpretation-variance + two refuted formula clusters + a couple of
infra faults, with essentially ONE fresh, non-refuted, verifiable prose lever (demo-sheet convention
matching), shipped here. If this is net-zero, the honest read is that remaining gains require
deterministic post-processing (enforce recalc-safe formulas / mirror a demonstration sheet
programmatically) or the infra fixes (269-44 literal-correct-but-0; 34-5 frozen "current month") —
both OUT of prose scope and to be handed to a human.

## Subagents / features used
Yes — 4 parallel read-only general-purpose subagents, one per failing-task group, then self-verified
the shipped lever against the 250-20 / 146-49 / 398-14 traces. task_template.md left UNTOUCHED
(all six placeholders intact).
